ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
---when you have more status, that should be hardcoded here according to the order
---for sequencing purposes.
PROCEDURE DO_RETRIEVE IS
 cursor cr_mst_code is select code from 
 valid_master_codes where code_type='DYSTS'
 order by decode(code,'OPEN','1','LIMIT','2','CLOSED','3');
 v_status_code valid_master_codes.code%type;
 v_temp NUMBER:=0;
BEGIN
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_resource_id is null then
 go_item('ctrl_blk_1.s_resource_id');
 show_error('0080');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 --message('Working...',no_acknowledge);--pitss synchronize; 
 select nvl(count(*),0)
 into v_temp 
 from valid_day_status
 where resource_code=:ctrl_blk_1.s_resource_id
 and :local_date between eff_date and nvl(term_date, :local_date+10);
 --and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id;
 
 IF v_temp > 0 then 
 go_block('valid_day_status');
 set_block_property('valid_day_status',default_where,'resource_code=:ctrl_blk_1.s_resource_id ') ; ---and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id');
 :system.message_level:=10;
 execute_query;
 :system.message_level:=0;
 go_item('valid_day_status.status');
 ELSE 
 if cr_mst_code%isopen then 
 close cr_mst_code;
 end if;
 set_block_property('valid_day_status',default_where,'resource_code=:ctrl_blk_1.s_resource_id '); --and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id');
 go_block('valid_day_status');
 open cr_mst_code;
 begin
 loop 
 FETCH cr_mst_code into v_status_code;
 EXIT when cr_mst_code%notfound;
 :valid_day_status.status:=v_status_code; 
 select description into :valid_day_status.s_status_des
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='DYSTS' 
 and code=v_status_code;
 :valid_day_status.lower_limit := 1;
 create_record;
 end loop;
 close cr_mst_code;
 end; 
 delete_record;
 first_record;
 go_item('valid_day_status.status');
 set_item_property('valid_day_status.status',insert_allowed,property_false);
 set_item_property('valid_day_status.status',navigable,property_false);
 END IF;
 --set_block_property('valid_day_status',INSERT_ALLOWED,property_false);
 --set_block_property('valid_day_status',UPDATE_ALLOWED,property_true);

 enable_disable('D');
END;

PROCEDURE enable_disable(pl_mode in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 if :system.cursor_item != 'CTRL_BLK_1.S_RESOURCE_ID' then
 item_change('ctrl_blk_1.s_resource_id',pl_mode);
 end if;
 
 if pl_mode='D' then
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_retrieve',enabled,property_false);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_lov',enabled,property_false);
 else
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_retrieve',enabled,property_true);
 set_item_property('ctrl_blk_1.pb_lov',enabled,property_true);
 end if;

END;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 v_upper_limit NUMBER;
 v_lower_limit NUMBER;
 v_status VARCHAR2(1);
BEGIN
 go_block('valid_day_status');
 first_record;
 Loop
 v_upper_limit:=:valid_day_status.upper_limit;
 next_record;
 v_lower_limit:=:valid_day_status.lower_limit;
 if (v_lower_limit-1) !=v_upper_limit then
 message('Status '||:valid_day_status.status||' has invalid limit ranges');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 if :system.last_record='TRUE' then
 exit;
 end if; 
 End loop;


 check_password(:banner.prog_name,v_status);
 if v_status = 'Y' then
 :system.message_level:=10;
 commit_form;
 :system.message_level:=0;

 if form_success then
 show_error('9163');
 end if;
 end if;

END;
